column1: #Text=Multiple `Error: Error(s) encountered during statement execution: database disk image is malformed` errors when opening the migration window for the first time, or after a Firefox restart
#Text=* Affected platforms: Windows 10x64 (only on one station)
#Text=1. Open the migration window and observe the browser console.
#Text=* No errors are displayed and the migration window is opened almost instantly.
#Text=* Multiple `Error: Error(s) encountered during statement execution: database disk image is malformed` errors and migration window takes some time to open.
#Text=* The errors are displayed only for the first time after the migration window is opened.
#Text=Opening the migration window again in the same session will no longer display the errors.
#Text=However, restarting Firefox will display the errors again but only for the first time.
#Text=* Note this happens on only one Windows 10 machine.
#Text=We have identified a cache invalidation issue when caching JDBC tables in Spark SQL.
#Text=The cached table is unexpectedly invalidated when queried, leading to a re-read from the JDBC table instead of retrieving data from the cache.
#Text=The expectation is that querying the cached table (cache_t) should retrieve the result from the cache without re-evaluating the execution plan.
#Text=However, the cache is invalidated, and the content is re-read from the JDBC table.
#Text=The issue lies in the 'CacheData' class, where the comparison involves 'JDBCTable.'
#Text=case class JDBCTable(ident: Identifier, schema: StructType, jdbcOptions: JDBCOptions)
#Text=The comparison of non-case class components, such as 'jdbcOptions,' involves pointer comparison.
